notes.title: ⚙️ Patch Note 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Just Date Vegan is now officially released and showing great results, but we still have a lot of work ahead to make the game even better and more accessible for all players.
Over the past week, we’ve released several updates. Here’s what’s changed:
[list]
[*] Added French language!
[*] Added a progress bar for animated scenes
[*] Fixed various bugs
[/list]
And a sneak peek at what’s coming in future updates:
[list]
[*] More language translations
[*] Support for new platforms and controllers
[/list]
We also want to say a huge thank you for helping bring our game to the top of the Steam charts! Stay with us — there’s much more to come! 💞

notes.title: Just Date Vegan is now available! 🎉

notes.title: 5 Days Until Release 💘
notes.notes:
Just a quick reminder that Just Date Vegan launches on April 14! Only one week left until you finally meet the stunning Lily. You still have time to brush up on your worst jokes — you’ll need them to impress her.

Here’s a sneak peek at what the final gameplay looks like:

[previewyoutube=erN2i7gXBTY;full][/previewyoutube]
And don’t forget to wishlist the game and follow us on socials — we’ve got plenty of surprises coming your way (and something extra fun planned for X/Twitter 👀).

notes.title: Get ready for a date! Just Date Vegan is on the final line! 🔥
notes.notes:
Over the past few months, the game has gone through a lot of changes, and we’re sure this part of Just Date is even more exciting and immersive. Here are some of the latest updates:

[h2]Improved Main Menu[/h2]
Buttons now look sleeker, animations are smoother, and you can even choose your own name at the start of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/34a3fcfb0aba9b7471a974df280459c8805e0353.gif[/img]

[h2]Lily is More Expressive Than Ever![/h2]
We've added new emotions and refined the existing ones. Maybe one of the reactions below is a response to your joke...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/ae0039fae4812f13c86dc9344e95c6487f386dac.png[/img]

[h2]New Dialogue Interface[/h2]
Designed specifically for making the most important decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/7778e56b8f284f7ce56f494c244d1e83fbb61824.gif[/img]

[h2]And… The Finale is Near![/h2]
As of today, all artwork and animations are complete! We've also put together an awesome game trailer, which you can check out on the main page. And while you're there, don’t forget to hit that "Add to Wishlist" button! ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/14db2991ce5cf8f90e10a9b3bc526353b0549c36.gif[/img]

So, what’s left before release? Just some final technical work, polishing dialogues, localization, and voice acting. Speaking of voice acting, the amazing [url=x.com/aliceinfernocos]Alice Inferno[/url] is voicing Lily — be sure to support her on X/Twitter.

Thank you for your support, patience, and wishlists! This spring, get ready for the hottest date of your life 🔥❤️

notes.title: Hello, everyone! 👋
notes.notes:
So far, we’ve completed the beginning of the date and are actively refining the main storyline—enhancing the script, working on technical details, and polishing the visual aspects. Here’s what’s ready:
[list]
[*] a new main menu background
[*] texting with Lily on the phone (yes, you can even get photos from her!)
[*] animation for two out of the four possible endings
[/list]
...and we’ve fixed several minor bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/4a2f26da97435ae79eb9774d5270c582ed56d832.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/051355aa70902dddc647a02ae742a268ac39956a.png[/img]

We’re paying special attention to the animation for the 18+ scenes, which you’ll see in the game. They’re turning out amazing (huge thanks to our animator)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/07b52defe704d713292e7b0b94920c6d0d3b61e8.gif[/img]

The game is currently 40% complete, and we’re not slowing down! A big thank you to everyone who has already tried the demo and shared feedback with us—you’re inspiring us to make awesome improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/f80287fb635910f8c18cf2521b0e8c948a922458.png[/img]

We’ll be back soon with more updates, so stay tuned and get ready for even more content! 💚
